title: Meeting rooms II
pattern: sweep with a heap of end times
statement: Given meeting intervals [start, end) (a meeting ending at t frees the room for one starting at t), return the minimum number of rooms needed.
hints: Sort by start; a min-heap of end times says when the earliest room frees up.
Equivalently: the maximum number of intervals overlapping at any instant.

solution.explanation: Two views of the same answer. Heap: process meetings by start; reuse the room that frees earliest if it's free by now, otherwise open a new one. Sweep: +1 at each start, −1 at each end, sorted with ends before starts at equal times; the running maximum is the answer. The tie rule (ends first) encodes the half-open intervals: ask about it.
